RepositoryRevision.digestSemantics: contentDigest is the authoritative digest under digestAlgorithm; treeDigest is optional provider-native tree evidence and never substitutes without the same named algorithm.

invariantRules.text: Source Repository identity is independent of hosting URL, provider, namespace locator, default branch and associated Software Product; host and namespace exist only in effective RepositoryLocator records.
A fork or independently governed mirror receives a distinct repository identity and records forkSourceRepositoryRef to its source.
Hosting migration appends effective RepositoryLocator records without rewriting repository or native source-revision identity; concurrent locators use distinct locatorId values.
Each immutable RepositoryRevision records nativeRevision, digestAlgorithm, authoritative contentDigest, commit time and provenance and is never replaced in place.
Branch and tag references are mutable aliases and never satisfy reproducible input without resolution to an immutable RepositoryRevision.
Repository access policy grants no product, runtime, release or deployment authority by implication.
Repository records and projections contain no credential, private key, token, secret or reversible secret representation.
Transfer, archive and retirement append RepositoryStatusPeriod history and preserve revision resolution and provenance.
Ownership and stewardship changes append RepositoryOwnershipPeriod records and never mutate immutable revisions.
A retired repository has one RepositoryTombstone, remains resolvable through lastResolvableRevisionRef and its sourceRepositoryId is never recycled.
